definitions_frozen_here.terminal_admm_solve: solve K + 1 of the block's main log (W81 rule; layout A no polish n == K + 1, layout B polish n == K + 2); recovery attempts are in *_recovery*.log and must not be at the terminal cycle
definitions_frozen_here.g_b: w_b x n_pairs x mu_last / s (W73/W74/W81 primary formula; EUR of Q)
definitions_frozen_here.mu_floor_b: min(tol, cit x s) / (btf + 1); tol and cit from the options list printed before the run, cit = 1e-4 (IPOPT default) when absent; btf = 10 and mu_target = 0 required absent from the list (asserted); at_floor iff |mu_last / floor - 1| <= 1e-3, above iff mu_last / floor > 1 + 1e-3, below iff < 1 - 1e-3 (flagged)
definitions_frozen_here.g_floor_b: w_b x n_pairs x mu_floor_b / s (the at-floor counterfactual; equals w_b x n_pairs x cit / 11 when cit x s <= tol, independent of s)
definitions_frozen_here.decomposition: Delta G = P + S + C exactly, with P = sum_b w_b n_pairs cit_b / 11 over x0 minus unit (structural pair count, s cancels), S = Delta G_floor - P (non-zero only for blocks with cit x s > tol: scaling regime), C = Delta G - Delta G_floor (above-floor excess: incomplete convergence)

frozen_verdict_rule: Per pair, R = |Delta G_total| / bar_sum with the primary formula; R < 1 -> SUB-RESOLUTION. 'Sub-resolution everywhere it has been measured' iff R < 1 for SRP1 Phase A (W81, re-derived), SRP1 C2-baseline and 2x2 complete. 2x2 explanation: with Delta G = P + S + C, the supported explanation is the component whose signed share of Delta G_total is >= 0.5: C -> 'incomplete convergence', S -> 'scaling artifact', P -> 'structural pair-count difference'; if no share reaches 0.5 -> 'mixed, none dominant'. Shares are reported for all three regardless. The decomposition is an accounting identity on the estimate: it does not decide whether above-floor stopping is itself caused by the scaling (that would need solves).
